response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS average_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_gb_per_minute) AS mean_status_average FROM status_averages) SELECT sa.status, sa.total_scans, sa.average_gb_per_minute, sa.average_gb_per_minute - o.mean_status_average AS difference_from_mean FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_status_average IS NOT NULL
